title: Latest public results
description: Open Latest to see the club’s most recently completed tournament. No login required.

steps.title: Latest results
steps.body: Latest always shows the newest completed top-level tournament. The page may redirect to that event’s detail URL.

steps.title: Latest is the current tab
steps.body: The public bar highlights Latest. Use All results to browse older events, or Achievements for leaderboards.
steps.actionHint: Latest is the active public tab

steps.title: Completed standings
steps.body: The same completed Round Robin the club just finished is shown with standings (and print, covered in the detail walkthrough).
steps.resultNote: Newest completed tournament is on screen.
